messages.subject: Caspian / Aerelon licence - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the Aerelon licence and collaboration (codename Indigo). Aerelon want exclusivity in commercial aviation across the CarbonLedger platform and the patent portfolio, plus a development collaboration on aviation-specific modules. Heads of terms are close. Can you send through an engagement letter and a proposed team?

Thanks,
Sofia

Sofia,

Delighted to help. Engagement letter attached. I'll lead, with James Osei running day to day and Elena Marchetti supporting; we'll co-ordinate patent points with Hartington IP. Fee estimate £145k–185k plus VAT through completion. Please sign and return the copy at your convenience and we'll get going on the long-form.

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
